scope: Fresh development questions frozen before generation. Becomes a used development set after this run; not independent human validation.
model: Existing default 2B, unchanged app policy and paragraph reference pilot
reviewRules: Retain complete answers and all nonblank answer lines; do not select only convenient claims.
Label support against the exact packed excerpts, not a whole document or outside knowledge.
A multi-claim line needs support for every factual part.
Review coverage of the question separately from claim support.
Do not tune questions, prompts or gold labels after inspecting checker verdicts.
No automatic verified badge, rewriting, app integration or phone installation.

questions.question: How do producers and decomposers play different roles in an ecosystem? Include one example of each.
What makes an algorithm different from a computer program? Explain whether an algorithm must be written in code.
How are the nucleus and electrons arranged in an atom, and where is most of its mass?
What can a low p-value establish about a hypothesis, and what can it not establish?
